facts.fact: NIMC tells NIN holders to download its NINAuth App to instantly verify their NINs and authenticate, per The Guardian (Nigeria).
NIMC's NINAuth App, on iOS and Google Play, lets NIN holders verify their NIN, approve who sees their information and authenticate, per The Guardian (Nigeria).

NGA.note: Document says nothing on a civil register and ID link.
121 million NINs issued is a count with no population share stated.
Document says nothing on a number at birth.
NIMC upgraded the diaspora enrolment platform, but who operates, maintains or owns the system is not stated.
Document says nothing on public registers keyed on the NIN.

facts.fact: The Guardian (Nigeria) reports from checks that NIMC had issued 121 million NINs to Nigerians as of June 2025, 1.53 million of them to diasporans.

NGA.note: No biometric check, certification or population share is stated.
